name: Alice Fairchild
original_name: アリス・フェアチャイルド
source:
Naomi's daughter. When she meets Shinji she calls him 'Papa' but he asks her to call him 'Onii-chan'. Even though she's still very young she wants to have his baby.

Her 'favorite number' is 8
